name: How is plumbing handled when adding a bathroom and kitchenette to a suite?
description: Plumbing is routed from your existing water supply and waste lines, which may involve trenching concrete slabs to install new drains, vents, and supply pipes.

mainEntity.name: How is plumbing handled when adding a bathroom and kitchenette to a suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing connections depend on the location of your home's main water supply and sewer or septic lines. When adding a bathroom or kitchenette, contractors locate existing tie-in points to plan drain slope and water supply runs. For ground-floor additions or garage conversions over existing concrete slabs, plumbers may need to trench the slab to run drainpipes and vent lines. If the suite is built as a separate wing, extending plumbing further across the home increases labor and pipe runs, which is planned during initial structural design.
